mapper.select: SELECT r.role_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_type, r.status, r.data_scope_type, r.data_scope_detail, r.is_system, r.sort_no, r.created_time, r.updated_time, r.remark, creator.account_display as created_name FROM exp_role r LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON r.created_by = creator.account_id WHERE r.role_id = #{roleId}
